repos_data.description: Testcontainers is a NodeJS library that supports tests, providing lightweight, throwaway instances of common databases, Selenium web browser...
CLI tool for summarizing go test output. Pipe friendly. CI/CD friendly.
Professional lightweight testing mini-framework for Go.
Ruby on Rails like test fixtures for Go. Write tests against a real database

repo_meta_data.description: Testcontainers for Go is a Go package that makes it simple to create and clean up container-based dependencies for automated integration/smoke tests. The clean, easy-to-use API enables developers to programmatically define containers that should be run as part of a test and clean up those resources when the test is done.
